rationale: The pain is real but hyper-niche: Einstein Activity Capture custom email-field matching via Apex is a documented-but-broken capability that genuinely wastes developer time, yet the evidence base is a single Stack Exchange thread with limited engagement, and no willingness-to-pay signal exists. The Salesforce ecosystem does monetize implementation gaps, but this specific configuration problem is too narrow and too easily solved by a free community post or SI partner to justify a paid product. TAM arithmetic fails the minimum threshold: even assuming 5,000 affected Salesforce orgs globally, a $49–99 one-time guide yields a ceiling of ~$250K–$500K with near-zero repeatability and trivial copyability.
